step.name: a wake on a new day arms it
the next open shows it, once
a second open the same day shows nothing
a wake on a day already recapped arms nothing
an open with nothing armed shows nothing
quiet keeps it for a later open
muted never shows, and spends the day
a day that is not a day changes nothing
